# ResetTimer <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [System](BlitzPlus-System)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ResetTimer:Void timer:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timer` | In | Int32 | required | A timer from `CreateTimer`. |

## Description

Sets the tick count of a timer back to 0 and starts counting again from now.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Timer", 20, 20, 240, 100, Desktop(), 3)
tm = CreateTimer(4)
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $4001 And TimerTicks(tm) >= 8 Then ResetTimer tm
	If e = $4001 Then SetGadgetText win, "Ticks " + TimerTicks(tm)
Until e = $803
```
